rows.label: qst620304_msg0002
rows.name:
There is a white beach and clear
water. I think it is a nice place,
but...?

rows.label: qst620304_msg0003
rows.name: Oh, it's a nice place all right.

rows.label: qst620304_msg0004
rows.name: But maybe it needs a little more...

rows.label: qst620304_msg0005
rows.name:
What I mean is, it seems a bit unsafe,
and certainly very pretty in the day,
but what about when it gets dark...?

rows.label: qst620304_msg0006
rows.name:
When it comes to proposing, I
think nighttime is the way to go.

rows.label: qst620304_msg0010
rows.name:
Right. Proposing under the aurora with
an engagement ring set with a Bouquet
Stone...

rows.label: qst620304_msg0012
rows.name:
Where is a good place to see the
aurora?

rows.label: qst620304_msg0013
rows.name:
If I had to guess,
maybe God-Crossing Island?

rows.label: qst620304_msg0014
rows.name: Let's go check it out, then.

rows.label: qst620304_msg0015
rows.name:
I'd like to hear the opinion of one of
the women traveling with Rex-kun
there.
